title: KPC 2-fer file (data/fers/<area>.json) - the fields the accuracy checker reads
description: Matches the club's existing data/fers/<area>.json files unchanged. Only 'spots' is required; every other top-level key is ignored. Extra keys on a spot are allowed and ignored. The checker never writes this file.

ring.description: [[lon, lat], ...]. A polygon ring need not repeat its first point; for kind 'trail' the 'shape' list is the stored stretch LINE.

geometry.description: A ring/line, a list of rings (each its own polygon), or a list of polygons ([outer, hole, ...]); may also be the same thing serialised as a JSON string.

kind.description: area | same land | trail | river (water-only rows are kind 'area' with status 'water only: ...', or kind 'water-only')

status.description: candidate / very tight ... / not sure ... / water only: boat or kayak = LIVE (checked); starts with 'dropped' or 'merged' = skipped

center.description: [lat, lon] of the stored overlap's centre (the club uses the widest point)

box.description: [min lon, min lat, max lon, max lat] of the stored overlap

zone.description: trail rows: the stored 100-ft band polygon(s)

line_source.description: {ref: {by, line: 'data/trails/<ref>.json', note}}: the parks measured from an official LINE
